Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home , Lucknow And Others Counsel for Applicant :- Akhtar Husain,Surya Prakash Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No. 544 of 2022, under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC and 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station- Nighasan District Kheri.
In terms of the FIR it was alleged that the daughter of the informant aged about 12 years was enticed away by the applicant on 27.06.2022 and the entire family of the applicant helped him.

Subsequently, in the statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 CrPC, she disclosed her age as 19 years and stated that she had gone with the applicant on the asking of the applicant and Deepa Singh @ Gurmel Singh vs State Of U.P. sentences.text: thereafter she stayed at a home and thereafter she went to Nepal with the applicant, where physical relations were formed between them.
She also specifically stated that all the other accused no role to play.
In her statement, recorded under Section 164 CrPC, she admitted that she stayed with the applicant at Nepal for five days.
The tentative age of the victim is 15-16 years, as per the radiological examination.
Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

Considering the two statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 and 164 CrPC, which, prima facie, reflect consent on the part of the victim, there have been no material on record to conclusively determine the age of the victim at this stage, a case for bail is made out, particularly when the applicant has no criminal history.
Therefore, I am of the view that the applicant, who is in jail since 28.07.2022, is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant Deepa Singh @ Gurmel Singh be released on bail in the abovesaid first information report number on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 14.3.2024 Vipul  Deepa Singh @ Gurmel Singh vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home , Lucknow ... on 14 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/59530554/
